Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function midicps() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultMIDICPS  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).midicps (); // creates a UnaryMIDICPSUGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultMIDICPS  =  midicps(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryMIDICPSUGen
See also:
